## User Profile

Works across local software and agent orchestration, often in German. Expects local memory to be consulted rather than reconstructed from recall.

## User preferences

- Start substantial work RAG-first: check local wiki and memory before planning. [ad-hoc note]
- For a terse, ambiguous request such as `update`, clarify the target before changing anything.
  - nested detail line that must be ignored
- Treat exact file boundaries and STOP instructions as hard constraints.

## General Tips

- Verify an installed CLI through its resolved shim, installed package, and upstream version — not one signal alone.
- Before overwriting an existing screenshot, prove the page loaded and is not `about:blank`.
